verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair axis for a SaaS data-movement platform, but the evidence never documents a Fivetran CLI. The REST API is a developer building block, and the MCP server belongs to a different story. The Connector SDK plugins are skills added to third-party agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex CLI, etc.), not a first-party Fivetran CLI, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
